script:
Hi everyone! Hello, hello! Welcome to my live stream, my dear friends and neighbors! So happy to see all of you joining us today. Before we get into the good stuff, do me a favor ah. Look up there and tap that follow button right now. Why? Because the moment you follow us, you can claim a one dollar voucher immediately! Yes, one dollar off your purchase! But listen carefully, this voucher is only valid for twenty-four hours, so you must use it today, okay? Don't let it go to waste lor.

Today, I have something really special for my "kakais" and "mummies" out there. We are starting with a crazy offer for our early birds. For the first fifty people only, we have the ROYO PANDA Soft Deluxe Facial Tissues from the Baby Monster Series at a price that will make you smile. Look at the orange basket on your screen. The price starts from only twelve dollars and ninety-nine cents! Can you imagine? For thirty-six packs of premium tissue! This is a huge deal, so you have to be quick. Once those fifty sets are gone, the price will go up. Faster lock in your orders now!

Let me ask you something. Have you ever been outside, maybe at a hawker center, and you try to wipe your face with a cheap tissue? The moment you wipe, the tissue breaks into tiny white pieces and sticks all over your nose and chin. It’s so embarrassing, right? Or you try to wipe a spill on the table and the tissue just melts into a wet mess. That’s because most tissues are only two or three layers. They are thin and they are weak. And for those of us with babies, we worry about what we use on their skin. A lot of tissues out there use bleach or chemicals to make them look white, and that can be quite harsh for a baby’s delicate skin.

That is why I really want to recommend this ROYO PANDA series to you. This is not your ordinary tissue, sisters. This is five-ply! Yes, five layers of thickness in every single sheet! When you hold it, you can really feel the difference. It’s thick, it’s strong, and it feels so premium. Each pack comes with two hundred and forty sheets, and the size is one hundred and forty by one hundred and seventy millimeters. It’s just the right size to carry in your bag or put on your dining table.

What I love most is that it is made from premium virgin bamboo pulp. This makes it naturally soft and very gentle. We make sure there is no bleach and no fluorescent agents added. It is safe for everyone in the family, even for the smallest babies and those with very sensitive skin. It’s all about peace of mind, right? We want the best for our family but at a price that makes sense.

Let me show you a quick demonstration because seeing is believing, right? I have a bowl of water here. I’m taking one sheet of this ROYO PANDA tissue. Look at the thickness. Now, I’m putting it into the water until it’s completely soaked. Usually, other tissues would have dissolved by now. But look at this! I can pull it, I can stretch it, and it stays together. It’s so durable even when it’s wet! You can use it to wipe up water, wipe off oil, or even use it as a wet wipe for your hands when you are out. It’s so versatile and strong.

And the texture? Oh my goodness, it is so soft. It feels like a gentle cloud on your skin. If you are someone who uses tissue for your skincare routine, this is perfect for you. It won't leave those annoying lint pieces on your face. It’s hygienic too because the pull-out design is so smooth. You pull one, and the next one pops up ready for you, but stays clean inside the pack.

This bundle is so worth it. You get thirty-six packs! You can put one in the kitchen, one in every bedroom, one in the car, and even give some to your friends. With the Baby Monster design, the packaging is so cute! It’s perfect for Teachers Day gifts or as doorgifts for birthday parties. People will think you spent a lot of money because the quality is so high, but only you know how much you saved today!

I see the numbers going up! Twenty-five sets already gone! We only have twenty-five more sets left at this special opening price. If you have it in your cart, please check out now! Don’t wait ah, later the system updates and you miss the price, don't say I didn't warn you lor. Remember to apply your one dollar follower voucher to get even more savings.

For those who just joined, welcome to our home! We are talking about the ROYO PANDA thirty-six pack bundle. It’s five-ply, made from virgin bamboo pulp, and totally safe for babies. No chemicals, just pure softness. The price is between twelve dollars and ninety-nine cents to twenty-four dollars and ninety-nine cents depending on which bundle you choose. But the value is truly there. You are stocking up for months! No need to carry heavy bags of tissue from the supermarket every week. We deliver it straight to your door.

My team is telling me we are down to the last fifteen sets! Only fifteen sets left for the early bird price! Faster go to the orange basket. If you are still thinking about it, just look at the quality again. Five layers! Most brands only give you three. You use less because one sheet can do the job of three thin ones. It’s actually more economical in the long run.

I really care about you all getting the best value. I know how expensive things are getting, so when I find a deal like this, I have to share it with my neighbors. This tissue is durable, skin-friendly, and safe. What more can we ask for? It’s perfect for everyday use, from wiping spills to cleaning your baby’s messy face after a meal.

Last ten sets now! The countdown is starting! Ten, nine, eight... make sure you have clicked "place order." Seven, six, five... don't miss out on the Baby Monster series! Four, three, two, and one! 

For those who managed to grab it, congratulations! You are going to love the quality. For those who are still waiting, keep looking at the basket. If someone doesn't pay for their order in the next few minutes, the stock might jump back for a second. So keep your eyes peeled! 

Remember, this is about providing safety and comfort for your family. No harsh chemicals, just the softest bamboo pulp. Whether you are using it at home, in the office, or during travel, it's the reliable choice. Thank you so much for the support everyone! Keep those orders coming in and enjoy the premium quality of ROYO PANDA! Use that voucher before it expires in twenty-four hours! Grab your packs now and feel the five-ply difference!
